Conversely, Go fell out of the Top 10 permanently after being named Language of the Year in 2016, and Ruby dropped out of the Top 20, with Tiobe suggesting it may not return soon. Looking ahead, Tiobe cautiously predicts TypeScript could enter the Top 20 in 2026, and Zig showed strong momentum, climbing from #61 to #42 in 2025. The index is calculated using data from search engines, counting engineers, courses, and service providers using each language, and Tiobe emphasizes it should be used primarily for assessing the relevance of programming skills and guiding technology selection for new projects.
